title: 第十五章 提督上门贾府惊慌第十六章 贾环升职打脸众人
slug: 红楼我乃宗师贾环当登基为帝
lines: 宁荣街。
已经停了好几匹大马。
荣国府现在急的团团转。
神枢营的冯提督，这会正来到了荣国府，指名道姓让贾环出来。
贾政刚从工部回来，根本不知道今天白天京师发生了什么事。
而人家冯提督，带着人，已经等候多时了。
“这孽子，怕是又在外面惹了什么事，真真气煞我也！”
贾环捶胸顿足。
要说上次吴指挥使过来，是为了嘉奖贾环。
这次神枢营的冯提督，总不可能也是来嘉奖的吧？
定是那孽子在外恃功而骄，闯下大祸，这才惹得人来兴师问罪。
而这番动静，就连老祖宗贾母也被惊动了。
贾母喊来王夫人，让王夫人探下底细，到底是何事。
“实在不行，就让人去把子腾喊来。”
她这般交代，倒不是多中意贾环，只是事关贾府名声，总不能稀里糊涂的让人将孙子带走。
“老祖宗，这军营中的事情，都是有规矩的，那贾环在外犯了军规，就得军法处置……”
“就算是我兄长来了，也是没用的。”王夫人故作为难，心中巴不得贾环受挫，好换一阵清闲。
贾母长叹一口气：“这可如何是好？”
“老祖宗，您就放宽了心！贾环做了什么事，只能他自己去担着了，犯了军规，谁也救不了他！”
“唉，这环哥儿也是个不省心的，前些日子，我当他是学好了，哪晓得又惹事了。”
风言渐起，猜测纷纭。
而另一边，冯提督已经来了有一会了。
按理说贾环下值后回家，现在也应该到了。
可能是因为今日破了京师拐卖人口的大案，下值后跟其他人去吃点喝点也是正常。
冯提督倒是不急，在贾府中喝着优等的碧螺春，品茗慢慢等候。
贾宝玉听闻神枢营来了个冯提督，正等着逮捕贾环。
心里头高兴坏了！
这几日总见着赵姨娘耀武扬威，还哄了不少姐姐妹妹听她胡诌，夸赞贾环。
连宝姐姐都对贾环刮目相看！
如今可算是栽了跟头！
贾宝玉急匆匆的赶去了潇湘馆。
“林妹妹，林妹妹，贾环出事了，他出事了！”
刚入馆内，就见一个娇柔女子正在研磨着一块老墨，老墨要比新墨香很多，一边研磨，一边还闻了闻。
女子两弯似蹙非蹙罥烟眉，一双似泣非泣含露目，态生两靥之愁，娇袭一身之病。
此人不是别人。
正是十二金钗之一的林黛玉！
见是宝玉来了，林黛玉柔指微松，放下老墨，蹙着眉道：“嗯，环哥儿怎么了？”
贾宝玉想要压住自己兴奋的音调，但却克制不住。
“神枢营的冯提督，带着人，现在就在外面等着逮捕贾环，我就说他太过于嚣张，早晚是要出事的，果然如此，他犯了事，现在都等着抓他呢！”
“环三哥犯了什么事？”
问起犯了什么事，贾宝玉又回答不上来了，顿了顿，才道：“说是触犯军法的事，哎，可不要害了府里啊！”
贾宝玉言毕，赶紧离开潇湘馆。
他怕自己等下忍不住，大笑起来，发而让林妹妹觉得小气了。
content_en:
Ningrong Street.
Several large horses have been stopped.
Rongguo Mansion is now in a hurry.
Admiral Feng from Shenshu Camp arrived at Rongguo Mansion and asked Jia Huan to come out by name.
Jia Zheng had just returned from the Ministry of Industry and had no idea what happened in the capital during the day.
Admiral Feng and his people have been waiting for a long time.
"I'm afraid this scoundrel may have caused trouble outside again. He's really pissing me off!"
Jia Huan beat his chest and stamped his feet.
It should be said that the last time Commander Wu came over, it was to commend Jia Huan.
It’s impossible for Admiral Feng from Shenshu Camp to be here to reward him this time, right?
It must have been that evil boy who was arrogant because of his merits and caused great trouble, which is why people came to investigate.
Even the ancestor Jia Mu was alarmed by this movement.
Jia Mu called Mrs. Wang and asked Mrs. Wang to find out what was going on.
"If it doesn't work, just ask someone to call Zi Teng."
She explained this way not because she liked Jia Huan, but because it was related to the reputation of Jia's family and she couldn't just let her grandson be taken away in a daze.
"Ancestor, there are rules in this military camp. If Jia Huan violates military regulations outside, he will be dealt with according to military law..."
"Even if my brother comes, it's useless." Mrs. Wang pretended to be difficult, hoping in her heart that Jia Huan would be frustrated so that she could have some peace and quiet.
Mother Jia let out a long sigh: "What should we do?"
"Ancestor, please relax! Whatever Jia Huan did, he can only bear the responsibility himself. If he breaks military regulations, no one can save him!"
"Oh, Brother Huan is also careless. A few days ago, I thought he had learned well, but I didn't know he would cause trouble again."
"..."
Rumors began to spread and speculations abounded.
On the other side, Admiral Feng has been here for a while.
It stands to reason that Jia Huan would have gone home after his shift, and he should have arrived now.
Maybe it's because a major human trafficking case in the capital was solved today, so it's normal to go have something to eat and drink with others after getting off work.
Admiral Feng was not in a hurry, and waited slowly while sipping tea at Jia's residence, drinking high-quality Biluochun.
Jia Baoyu heard that Admiral Feng had come to Shenshu Camp and was waiting to arrest Jia Huan.
I am so happy!
In the past few days, I always see Aunt Zhao showing off her power and coaxing many sisters to listen to her nonsense and praise Jia Huan.
Even Sister Bao admires Jia Huan with admiration!
Now it can be regarded as a failure!
Jia Baoyu hurried to Xiaoxiang Pavilion.
"Sister Lin, sister Lin, something happened to Jia Huan, something happened to him!"
As soon as I entered the museum, I saw a delicate woman grinding a piece of old ink. The old ink was much more fragrant than the new ink. She was grinding and smelling it.
The woman has eyebrows that look like they are frowning but not frowning, and her eyes look like weeping but not weeping. Her expression is filled with the sorrow of two dimples, and she is suffering from the disease of her whole body.
This person is no one else.
It is Lin Daiyu, one of the Twelve Golden Hairpins!
Seeing that Baoyu was coming, Lin Daiyu loosened her fingers slightly, put down Lao Mo, frowned and said, "Well, what's wrong with Brother Huan?"
Jia Baoyu wanted to suppress his excitement, but couldn't.
"Admiral Feng from Shenshu Camp and his men are waiting outside to arrest Jia Huan. I said he is too arrogant and something will happen to him sooner or later. Sure enough, he has committed something and everyone is waiting to arrest him now!"
"What did Brother Huan San commit?"
"Um, this..."
When asked what he had committed, Jia Baoyu couldn't answer again. He paused and then said: "You said it was a violation of military law. Hey, don't harm the house!"
After Jia Baoyu finished speaking, he quickly left the Xiaoxiang Pavilion.
He was afraid that he wouldn't be able to hold it back later and burst into laughter, which would make Sister Lin feel stingy.
title_en: Chapter 15: The admiral comes to Jia's house and panics Chapter 16: Jia Huan gets promoted and slaps everyone in the face
